examples.title: Hello Node
examples.description: Run one TypeScript server per worktree: devlanes gives it a port, an HTTPS hostname and a ready check.

examples.title: Ready checks
examples.description: Pick the right ready check for each service: http, tcp, log and cmd, including apps that answer only on their own hostname.

examples.title: Frontend and API
examples.description: Connect a React frontend to its API per lane: public_url for the browser, url for server-to-server calls, CORS from DEVLANES_ORIGINS and a cookie on the lane domain.

examples.title: Next.js app
examples.description: Run Next.js per lane with the next preset, and fetch an HTTPS sibling from a server component without TLS workarounds.

examples.title: WebSockets and SSE
examples.description: Serve WebSockets and server-sent events through the proxy, with extra named ports routed to their own hostnames.

examples.title: Wildcard tenants
examples.description: Serve tenant subdomains on a site with its own cookies, behind a fallback wildcard gateway and an exact short-link host.

examples.title: Provider stubs
examples.description: Replace third-party SMS and email providers with local fakes per lane, so each lane's messages land in its own inbox.

examples.title: Python and FastAPI
examples.description: Run FastAPI under uv behind the HTTPS proxy, with forwarded headers, Jinja pages and HTTPS calls trusted through SSL_CERT_FILE.

examples.title: Rust and axum
examples.description: Run Rust services with run_script on Cargo.toml, a ready timeout for the first build, and reqwest trusting the devlanes CA.

examples.title: Polyglot lane
examples.description: Run Node, Bun, Deno, Python and Rust services in one lane through every run_script runner.

examples.title: Cloudflare Workers
examples.description: Run two Workers per lane with the wrangler preset: a service binding resolved through the lane's own dev registry, KV state in the lane data folder and inspector hostnames.

examples.title: Cloudflare Vite plugin
examples.description: Run a React app and a Worker in one Vite server per lane, with the inspector port and persisted state taken from devlanes.

examples.title: Tauri desktop app
examples.description: Run a Tauri 2 app per lane with its own identifier per lane and replica, against a Vite frontend devlanes runs.

examples.title: Shared Postgres
examples.description: Share one Postgres container between lanes with a database per lane, and run setup, migrations, seeds and resets at the right lane events.

examples.title: Postgres per lane
examples.description: Give each lane its own Postgres container next to a shared Redis, and remove a lane's container and volume with lane clean.

examples.title: Many datastores
examples.description: Set up and tear down Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, RabbitMQ, an S3 store and Mailpit, each namespaced per lane or run per lane.

examples.title: Plain containers
examples.description: Run containers without Compose, such as a mock OIDC provider per lane, and route a server you start yourself with infra.external.

examples.title: Profiles and tags
examples.description: Organise many services with tags, colours, templates and profiles, including a test profile and one that attaches to lane 0's APIs.

examples.title: Queue workers
examples.description: Run port-less worker replicas that finish their job on stop, keep their lane awake and share a queue namespaced per lane.

examples.title: pnpm monorepo
examples.description: Run a pnpm and turbo workspace with a service per package, build steps at lane creation and a subdirectory project with its own lanes.

examples.title: Dev and prod
examples.description: Switch a lane between dev servers and a production build with a profile, run a second project file beside it, and keep personal changes in devlanes.local.yaml.

examples.title: Env files
examples.description: Feed values from a gitignored .env into named variables, share it with new worktrees, and derive every URL from one domain root.

examples.title: Migrating from mprocs
examples.description: Replace mprocs, Caddy and a hand-made port-slot script with devlanes, item by item.

examples.title: Tests in CI
examples.description: Start a lane, run tests against its HTTPS URLs and stop it again with devlanes with, locally and in GitHub Actions.

examples.title: Tool versions
examples.description: Pin each lane's tool versions and variables with mise and direnv files in the worktree root.

examples.title: TUI tour
examples.description: Walk through the devlanes TUI key by key on the stack from the devlanes.run demo: infra, tasks, profiles, a failing service, the monitor and freezing.

examples.title: Many services
examples.description: Start 40 services at once to see the start gate queue them, and read CPU and memory per unit in status and the monitor.

examples.title: Broken on purpose
examples.description: Trigger each failure devlanes reports, from crashes and wrong ports to every proxy error page, and read what each one tells you.

examples.title: Remote box in Docker
examples.description: Run lanes on a box in a container and use them from your machine: pairing, mirrored hostnames, hidden services and synced folders.

examples.title: Remote box over SSH
examples.description: Prepare a Linux server as a devlanes box and connect to it over SSH, Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel.
